| `block land` | Plain land, `--merge` with the selected-test merge gate, `--no-merge-gate`, active grants and `hooks.on_block_end`. A batch land's merge gate links `gates.merge_gate_links`, runs `gates.merge_gate_setup` and honours `--copy-links` like a single land (B589). A batch whose `--max` deadline runs out, in a block's rebase, changed gates or trial merge or in the merge gate, refuses the whole batch with no culprit and lands nothing (B662). A retry of a closed block (a land that failed after close) stays in Go when the run has active autopilot approvals, since the retry ends no block (B589). `land.require_ci: github` (opt in) checks GitHub CI for each block's own tip with `gh` before any hand-over, merge or write and refuses at step `ci` unless it is green or red only on known reds (`land.ci_red_list`, `CODE_FORGE_CI_RED_BLOCKS`) (B765). With `native.daemon: false` land runs its review join in this process like `review-file --wait-block`, and a retry of a closed block needs no join at all, so the setting no longer stops land (B789). A merge conflict whose files are all append-only (`CHANGELOG.md` bullets, rows of the `land.auto_resolve.tables` files, `land.auto_resolve.generated` files) is resolved in Go in the trial merge, the merge into main and a batch's precheck and rebases, with a signed `land.resolved` row; any other conflict aborts the merge with main unchanged, prints the files with their kinds and one `next:` step, and writes a signed `land.conflict` row (B795). | The gates step (B450), no compatible join daemon while the daemon is on, the join, claim and close steps Go does not serve, and run state Go does not expect. A run file Go cannot read prints Node's read error in Go (B470). Read-only pre-checks finish before the first write. The B282 reason code names the step. `--help` and `-h` print the usage in Go (B451). |
